'''Lauren Kammerling''' is a voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Kammerling was born in Louisville, Kentucky, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where she voiced [[Acerola]]. Kammerling is currently based in New York and affiliated with Ingrid French Management. In 2021, Kammerling married fellow Pokémon Voice Actor [[Jeremy Levy]].
